args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was deployed to all production regions and began failing health checks (error rate 0.18). Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release v2.3.0 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west).

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and failing health checks with an error rate of 0.18. The deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release, while v2.3.0 was the most recent healthy production version.

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled `checkout-api` back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback completed successfully.

3. **Opened a SEV2 incident**: Created incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy") describing the unhealthy deploy and the rollback to v2.3.0. The on-call engineer was paged.

4. **Verified recovery**: Confirmed the service is now on v2.3.0 in all regions, healthy, with error rate back down to 0.002.

Note: I did not deploy any new version — the rollback went to a previously healthy production release, so no change-manager approval was required.
